overview: This Senate resolution honors boxer George Foreman, who died in Houston on March 21, 2025. It recounts his rise from the Job Corps job-training program to an Olympic gold medal in 1968, two world heavyweight championships including becoming the oldest heavyweight champion in 1994, and a career record of 76 wins and 5 losses. It also recognizes his work as a minister, his youth and community center in Houston, and his business success with the George Foreman grill. The resolution sends copies to the House and his family. The Senate adopted it, and on May 14, 2025, amended its preamble by unanimous consent.
for: Supporters say it honors a sports legend whose life also showed commitment to faith, community and helping young people.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
